record.field: AI Tool: MCP Retrieve initial context

Retrieves information about the current user, their timezone and their companies. MANDATORY: You MUST call this tool exactly once at the very beginning of every conversation, before invoking any other tool or producing any response to the user. It returns essential context that is required to correctly use every other tool: the current user, their timezone, their active company and all companies available to them, plus general instructions. Skipping this call will lead to incorrect tool usage (wrong timezone, wrong company scope). Do not call it more than once in the same conversation.
